summary: Executed full backend + frontend E2E testing for ReachInbox. All 14 pytest backend tests passed (health, auth, schedule with dedup/invalid handling, list/pagination, stats, retry 409-on-non-failed, real BullMQ+Ethereal end-to-end send within 10s with previewUrl, search, Slack connect/status/disconnect). Frontend Playwright flow passed: login via 'Continue with Google' -> /dashboard, all stat cards, tab switching, global search dropdown, compose modal (detected-count = '2 email addresses detected' for the required paste input), compose submit closes modal and new rows appear in scheduled table, settings page (slack inputs), queue monitor page, and user menu opens with Logout entry.
critical_code_review_comments: All required data-testids are present and functional.
Backend correctly normalizes recipients (case-insensitive dedup) and ignores invalid emails (verified: 4 inputs -> 2 valid, 1 duplicate, 1 invalid).
Retry endpoint correctly rejects non-failed jobs with 409.
Real BullMQ delayed job pipeline verified end-to-end (scheduled -> sent with Ethereal previewUrl within seconds); no cron/setInterval fallbacks detected.
test_credentials: Dev sign-in only: click 'Continue with Google' (data-testid=google-signin-button) -> demo user vishnu@reachinbox.ai. API: POST /api/auth/dev-login {} -> data.token.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests scheduled several TEST_-prefixed campaigns plus one real-send E2E campaign (2 recipients). No prod-critical data modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_reachinbox.py covers all API contracts including real send. Frontend flows are stable and all data-testids resolve. If retesting frontend logout, use selector 'text=Logout' or add data-testid=logout-button to the DropdownMenuItem (my prior compound selector 'a,text=Logout' was invalid CSS — not an app bug; screenshot confirms Logout item renders in user menu).
rca of the issue: No production issues found. Sole test-script bug was an invalid mixed CSS/text Playwright selector for logout in my UI script; corrected verification via screenshot showing Logout visible in the opened user menu.
